spec.kitLine: beginning of Full Burst: Charge Dmg ▲
spec.scope: Charge-bucket damage only (chargeDamagePct, additive percentage points in the charge bucket) — NOT generic attackDamagePct and NOT chargeDamageMultPct (no 'multiplier'/'of damage' wording in the line).
spec.durationSemantics: Wall-clock 10 sec (durationSec:10). Literal 'for 10 sec' — no rounds/stacks ambiguity. With the ~10s Full Burst window this buff spans essentially the whole FB.
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnter — 'Activates at the beginning of Full Burst' is the canonical any-team-FB wording. NOT burstCast: yan is a Burst I unit, so on any team where another B1 (e.g. liter) takes the cast, the two readings diverge.
spec.targetSet: All allies including self ({kind:'allies'}, no excludeSelf). Yan is RL (chargeFrames 90) so she self-benefits; charge-weapon allies (RL/SR) benefit; non-charge allies hold an inert buff.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Trigger keyed to burstCast (fires only on rotations yan herself casts B1) instead of fullBurstEnter; secondary misread: chargeDamageMultPct (scales base charge damage) instead of additive chargeDamagePct.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: In a comp where liter holds the B1 cast (yan present but never bursting — assert via burstCast events that yan's srcSlot never casts), a buffApply {stat:'chargeDamagePct', value:21.55} still fires at EVERY fullBurstStart, targeting all 5 units. Green under fullBurstEnter; zero applications (red) under burstCast. Additionally assert stat==='chargeDamagePct' (raw 21.55), not 'chargeDamageMultPct'.
spec.inertness: Must not move a non-charge-weapon ally's damage at all (chargeDamagePct only feeds the charge bucket); must not apply outside the 10s window (expiresFrame ≈ applyFrame + 600).

spec.scope: Generic ATK buff on each target's OWN ATK (atkPct) — the kit says plain 'ATK ▲', not 'x% of the skill user's ATK', so NOT casterAtkPct (which would flat-add off yan's low Supporter staticAtk 98,367).
spec.durationSemantics: Wall-clock 5 sec (durationSec:5), refreshed on every full-charge shot. Yan's cadence (90f charge + 22f release latency ≈ 1.9s/shot, ammo 6, reload 141f ≈ 2.35s) means the 5s window bridges her reload — near-permanent uptime is EMERGENT from refresh, not something to encode as passive.
spec.triggerIdentity: Per full-charge attack by yan — for an RL that always full-charges, this is her per-pull trigger (shotFired; a chargeCounter count:1 encoding is equivalent). On-attack, no FB gate, no status gate. NOT interval, NOT fullBurstEnter, and critically NOT passive: a passive never lapses and applies at t=0 before her first shot even lands.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoded as an always-on passive self/team buff ('she always full-charges anyway') — over-credits t=0 through her first ~1.9s charge and any stun/downtime, and erases the refresh cadence; secondary misread: casterAtkPct (flat add of yan's ATK) instead of atkPct.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Assert (a) NO buffApply {stat:'atkPct', key matching yan skill2} before yan's first shot event (first apply frame ≥ ~112f), (b) repeated buffApply refreshes tracking her shot events one-to-one across the fight, (c) stat==='atkPct' with raw value 2.77 (plain percentage stats keep the kit %), targetIdx covering all 5 slots. Green under per-full-charge trigger; red under passive (single frame-0 apply) and red under casterAtkPct (stat/value would be a flat ~2725 ATK).
spec.inertness: Must not apply while yan has fired nothing; value must not scale with yan's own buffed ATK (it is each target's own-ATK %).

spec.kitLine: on Full Charge attack: Crit Rate ▲
spec.scope: GENERIC Critical Rate (critRatePct) — the line has no 'of normal attacks' scoping, so critRateNormalPct would be an over-narrowing misread here (the inverse of the usual scope trap).
spec.durationSemantics: Wall-clock 5 sec (durationSec:5), same refresh-per-full-charge shape as the ATK line.
spec.triggerIdentity: Same block as the ATK line: per full-charge attack (shotFired-equivalent), two effects on one trigger.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Scoped to normal attacks only (critRateNormalPct), suppressing crit on allies' skill/burst hits; or dropped entirely as 'too small to matter' (1.33% is small but team-wide and near-permanent uptime).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Assert buffApply {stat:'critRatePct', value:1.33} accompanies each atkPct application (same trigger frame, same targets). Green under generic critRatePct; red if the stat is critRateNormalPct or the effect is absent.
spec.inertness: Must not exceed 1.33 or stack multiplicatively across refreshes (refresh, not stack — no maxStacks in the text).

spec.kitLine: Deals 348.73% of final ATK as damage
spec.scope: One instant AoE damage instance off yan's final ATK at cast (flatDamage atkPct:348.73, burst bucket). Single boss target at scope lock, so 'enemies within attack range' collapses to one hit.
spec.durationSemantics: Instant, on cast. Burst I, cd 20s.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (yan's own Burst I cast) — fires ONLY on rotations yan actually takes the B1 slot; in a comp with liter, first-ready selection decides who casts, so the damage must track yan's own burstCast events, never every rotation.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Crediting the hit with the +50% Full Burst major (methodology: burst-cast/instant damage always lands BEFORE the FB window opens and is FB-exempt); secondary misread: letting it take the +30% range bonus (riders are force-no-range).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: For each yan burstCast event, assert exactly one damage event {srcSlot: yan, bucket:'burst', mult ≈ 348.73} with fbMajorApplied===false and inFullBurst===false (and rangeApplied per the engine's rider force-no-range rule). Green under FB-exempt burst-cast damage; red if fbMajorApplied is true. Also assert damage count === yan's burstCast count (no per-rotation over-fire).
spec.inertness: Must contribute zero damage on rotations where yan does not cast; must not double-hit (single enemy, one instance per cast).

spec.scope: Boss crowd-control / positioning pull — the sim has no boss position mutation channel, and the scope-lock boss follows a measured range script (a measured constant, never refit).
spec.triggerIdentity: On yan's burst cast, applied to the boss.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Fudging it as a range-band improvement for the team (modeling an unobserved positioning benefit to 'capture' the pull) — a measured>fudge violation against the measured boss range script.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Assert the boss range band / rangeApplied pattern on the team's shots is IDENTICAL with the burst block's movement line present vs absent (inertness pin) — the line must live verbatim in unmodeled.burst, not as an effect.
spec.inertness: Must not move any unit's damage, range eligibility, or the boss range script.

loadBearingSet: skill1:Charge Damage ▲21.55% for 10 sec (fullBurstEnter, all allies)
skill2:ATK ▲2.77% for 5 sec (per full-charge attack, all allies)

burst: Forced movement toward the center of attack range, lasts for 2 sec.

notes: Three reconciliation points. (1) Yan is BURST I — the controlComp fixture (liter B1 / crown B2 / carry B3 / helm B3) places the carry at B3, so yan cannot sit in the carry slot as-is; the test comp must slot yan alongside a real B3 and must decide the B1 contention with liter explicitly (first-ready in-window selection). This B1 collision is exactly what makes skill1's trigger testable: with liter taking the B1 cast, fullBurstEnter (faithful) still fires every FB while burstCast (nearest-wrong) fires never — I expect a shared-prior misread here because on any comp where yan IS the sole/actual B1 caster the two readings coincide and a calibrated board would hide it. (2) skill2's expected trap is the opposite of the usual one: the crit line is GENERIC (no 'normal attacks' scoping), so an over-cautious critRateNormalPct encoding would under-credit; and the ATK line is plain atkPct, not casterAtkPct — assert on the emitted raw value 2.77 to pin this (a casterAtkPct misencoding emits a flat ~2725). Also reject any passive encoding of skill2: uptime is near-permanent EMERGENTLY (5s window bridges the 141-frame reload), but a passive applies at frame 0 before her first ~112-frame charge+latency completes — assert first-apply frame. (3) Burst damage must be FB-exempt (lands pre-FB-window; fbMajorApplied false) — applying the +50% is the classic over-credit on burst-cast damage. All four magnitudes (21.55 / 2.77 / 1.33 / 348.73) are literal kit text; no ALWAYS-⚑ fields are needed beyond the standard cadence tuple, which the harness already pins via base stats (chargeFrames 90 / reloadFrames 141 / ammo 6).
